stem.text: Which structure best represents the species in the vapour at this temperature?

A.alt: Al2Cl6 dimer with two bridging Cl atoms; arrows drawn from the bridging Cl atoms to the Al atoms.

B.alt: Al2Cl6 dimer with two bridging Cl atoms; arrows drawn from the Al atoms to the bridging Cl atoms.

C.alt: AlCl3 drawn with Al bonded to three Cl atoms (two above, one below).

D.alt: Al3+(Cl-)3 formula written on one line.
